Bug_Title: Mockito argument matchers should be used on all parameters
Bug_Details:
Mockito provides argument matchers and argument captors for flexibly stubbing or verifying method calls.
Mockito.verify() , Mockito.when() , Stubber.when() and BDDMockito.given() each have overloads
with and without argument matchers.
However, if argument matchers or captors are used only on some of the parameters, all the parameters need to have matchers as well, otherwise an InvalidUseOfMatchersException will be thrown.
This rule consequently raises an issue every time matchers are not used on all the parameters of a stubbed/verified method.
Bug_Explanation: The function 'whenCalculatorAdd' simulates an incorrect matcher setup for method stubbing, where only one parameter uses a matcher, causing the intended bug.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls MockitoArgumentMatchersExample.showBug(), which internally triggers the bug by calling whenCalculatorAdd with mismatched argument usage. The method whenCalculatorAdd incorrectly simulates Mockito.when() behavior with only one parameter using a matcher.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate 'OK (1 test)', which means the test passed without any exceptions or errors. This suggests that the bug related to Mockito argument matchers not being used on all parameters was not triggered during the test.
